attempts.summary: Created a hardened systemd service `inventory-worker` on node1 running as a dedicated unprivileged system user, confined to write only within /var/lib/inventory via ProtectSystem=strict + ReadWritePaths, with NoNewPrivileges=true and additional sandboxing (PrivateTmp, PrivateDevices, capability/ambient-capability stripping, MemoryDenyWriteExecute, etc.). Verified the service is enabled and actively appending heartbeat/log data, confirmed a write attempt outside the allowed path is blocked (Permission denied), then performed the mandatory single-node restart: captured boot_id baseline (83a0a80f...), issued `systemctl reboot`, polled until reconnection, confirmed a changed boot_id (d8a63ff9...) proving an actual restart, and verified the service came back enabled/active and resumed writing new heartbeat/log entries in /var/lib/inventory after boot.
